title: Uruguayan Casserole
description: A hearty casserole originating from Uruguay, made with ground beef, tomatoes, and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once browned, add tomato paste, zesty seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add chopped plum tomatoes and stir to combine.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked rice, ground beef mixture, and shredded cheddar.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
